card.name: Numbers before "times" in frequencies
card.fires_on: The number 2, 3 or 4 (or the word three) right before "times" in a frequency such as "2 to 3 times per week". Also fires on digits inside longer numbers such as a street address.

modes.label: Frequency count
modes.description: A small number or the word three, placed just before "times" in a per-day or per-week frequency.
modes.example: Speech services are provided during 30 - 45 minute intervals from 2 - <<3>> times per week.

modes.label: Digits in other numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an address or dose number, not a frequency.
modes.example: Event Location: 29<<6>>0 Peralta Oaks Court, Oakland

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like "total" and away from street words, which is only a weak effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the number in phrases like "2 to 3 times a week" or "three times daily".
